Amazon’s Black Friday event is in full swing and so too are the many Green Deals you can take advantage of, with everything we’ve spotted being added to our one-stop seasonal hub here . Headlining today’s edition is the latest EcoFlow 48-hour flash sale with up to $3,238 savings on options like the new TITAN 5000 Classic Power Station down at a new $2,089 low . You can also hop on Velotric’s Nomad 2 All-Terrain e-bike with a FREE extra battery and mirror ($540 value) at $1,799 , or the EGO Power+ Z6 42-inch Cordless Zero-Turn Riding Mower with 6x batteries and a wall charger at its $4,499 low – plus, more deals waiting below.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow flash sale drops TITAN Classic whole-home power station to new $2,089 low ($1,210 off), more from $854
With EcoFlow’s Black Friday savings in full swing , the brand has launched a 48-hour flash sale with up to $3,238 savings taken off four power station units – with two featuring the new TITAN Series. The first of those is the TITAN Classic Portable Power Station for $2,089.05 shipped , after using the code EFBFCMAFF at checkout, beating Amazon by $110 . Normally you can’t stack the overall sale’s bonus extra savings code on flash units, but this isn’t the case for the new TITAN models included here. Down from $3,299, we saw this model launch at the top of the month at $2,374, which is where it remained during the early Black Friday deals, only falling further to $2,199 once the expanded event went live last week. This is a combined $1,210 markdown that lands things at a new all-time low. You can find all the other flash offers below, or shop from the full sale lineup here .
***Note: While extra savings codes typically do not stack with flash savings, the TITAN Series deals here are getting the rare opportunity to benefit from the sitewide bonus savings code EFBFCMAFF , taking an extra 5% off the cost.

Travel up to 130 miles with Velotric’s Nomad 2 all-terrain e-bike + extra battery and mirror down at $1,799 ($740 savings)
As part of Velotric’s expanded Black Friday e-bike sale , we just spotted an amazing bundle deal for the Nomad 2 All-Terrain Fat Tire e-bike with a FREE extra battery and mirror ($540 value) down at $1,799 shipped . Down from $1,999 here, over the last three months we’ve only seen it getting bundled with the extra battery at full price, with the discounted price here only beaten by a dip lower to $1,749 back in August. You’re getting a $200 markdown off the tag and $740 total combined savings for the second-lowest price we have tracked, as well as the largest overall savings to date.
You can learn all about the e-bike here , or shop the full Velotric sale lineup here .
EGO’s Z6 42-inch cordless zero-turn riding mower + 6x batteries and wall charger drops to $4,499 low ($801 off), more
As part of Amazon’s ongoing Black Friday Sale event , you can currently find the EGO Power+ Z6 42-inch Cordless Zero-Turn Electric Riding Lawn Mower with 6x 6.0Ah batteries + 880W Wall Charger down at $4,499 shipped . Down from $5,300, you’re looking at a solid $801 markdown here off the going rate, which we’ve seen once before this year back in June. This is the best price we have tracked for this particular bundle, letting you upgrade your lawn care routine with significant savings.
Jackery’s newest Fridge Guard power station + expansion battery gets first savings to $1,099 low ($260 off)
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday Sale , via its official storefront, Jackery is currently offering the first discount on its latest Fridge Guard Power Station with an expansion battery for $1,099 shipped , which matches the deal from the direct website sale . So far, this is the only deal we’ve seen from Jackery’s current full Black Friday sale , which is a first-time discount since it released at the top of the month. It’s dropping down from a $1,359 full price here, giving you $260 in savings for a new low.
You can learn more about this new Fridge Guard station right here .
Beatbot’s 2026 Sora 70 is a 5-in-1 robot pool cleaner down at a new $949 low ($550 off), more from $303
Alongside the Amazon Black Friday Sale , Beatbot has launched its direct Black Friday pool sale , complete with some FREE gifts, 2x member points, and a bonus extra savings code. Of course, my top pick is the 2026 Sora 70 5-in-1 Robotic Pool Cleaner with a FREE winter storage cover down at $949.05 shipped , after using the code AFF5 at checkout, beating out Amazon by $50 . Down from $1,499, this model has mostly seen discounts to $1,099 since hitting the market in February, with drops further to $999 during June and October’s Prime Day events. Now, thanks to the bonus savings code, you’re able to get a combined $550 markdown for a new all-time low. You’ll find the entire lineup of robot pool cleaner deals down below.
***Note: We’ve factored in the extra savings to the prices you see below, so be sure to use the code AFF5 at checkout for these absolute best deals during this sale.
